selection.edition: international BotStar Public API v1 covering Composio BOTSTAR HTTP tools
selection.ownership: BotStar / BOTSTAR VIET NAM LIMITED COMPANY (CÔNG TY TNHH BOTSTAR VIỆT NAM), Da Nang, Vietnam; founders Huy Dinh and Tuong Le. English SaaS at botstar.com and apis.botstar.com. Vietnam is not mainland China; this is the global Public API edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official BotStar account profile token generation (https://app.botstar.com/account/profile), pinned Public API v1 at https://apis.botstar.com/v1 (Bearer, GET /bots/, GET /bots/{id}, GET /bots/{id}/attributes, GET /bots/{id}/cms_entities), CMS product docs, Da Nang Vietnam operator, and dated incident search (BotStar + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved BotStar compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

BotStar Public API v1 is a fixed-host Bearer API at apis.botstar.com. Official REST OpenAPI is not published as a standalone reference; token minting is documented on the BotStar account profile, and GET /v1/bots is corroborated by Pipedream and Quickwork. Dated 2026-09-13 incident search found no qualifying unresolved BotStar compromise. Vietnamese ownership does not make this a mainland-China edition.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: botId is required. Optional env is draft or live. Returns the raw attribute array under data instead of the upstream {attributes} wrapper.
botId is a required URL-encoded path segment on GET /bots/{botId}. Returns raw bot JSON under data instead of the upstream {bot} wrapper.
Maps to pinned GET /bots/. Returns the raw bot array under data instead of the upstream {bots} wrapper. Writes are omitted.
botId is required. Optional env is draft or live. Returns the raw CMS entity array under data instead of the upstream {entities} wrapper. CMS writes are omitted.
Credential-only healthcheck maps to pinned GET /bots/ (trailing slash) on https://apis.botstar.com/v1, matching the pinned validator.
Pinned source always sends Content-Type: application/json, including on GET. Native GETs omit the upstream user-agent.
Pipedream documents GET https://apis.botstar.com/v1/bots without the trailing slash; this recipe follows pinned source.
Native category is messaging (source Communication/Marketing are not in Rust CATEGORIES).
Maps to pinned POST /bots/ with {name}. Trailing slash matches list/healthcheck.
Maps to pinned POST /bots/{botId}/publish. Composio slug is BOTSTAR_PUBLISH_BOT.
POST /bots/{botId}/attributes. additional_values/localizedValues flatten into value_<lang> body keys via handwritten handler.
PATCH /bots/{botId}/attributes/{attributeId}. Multilingual values flatten like create.
DELETE /bots/{botId}/attributes/{attributeId} with optional env=draft|draft,live.
GET /bots/{botId}/cms_entities/{entityId}.
POST /bots/{botId}/cms_entities with name and optional fields array.
PATCH /bots/{botId}/cms_entities/{entityId} with {name}.
DELETE /bots/{botId}/cms_entities/{entityId}.
POST /bots/{botId}/cms_entities/{entityId}/fields with a JSON array body.
PATCH /bots/{botId}/cms_entities/{entityId}/fields with a JSON array body.
DELETE /bots/{botId}/cms_entities/{entityId}/fields?unique_names=a,b.
GET /bots/{botId}/cms_entities/{entityId}/items with env, name, page, limit, status.
GET /bots/{botId}/cms_entities/{entityId}/items/{entityItemId}.
POST /bots/{botId}/cms_entities/{entityId}/items. additional_fields/data/custom_fields flatten into the JSON body via handwritten handler.
PATCH item; custom field maps flatten like create.
DELETE /bots/{botId}/cms_entities/{entityId}/items/{entityItemId}.
POST /bots/{botId}/users/attributes with {field_name, field_type}.
LIVECHAT_BOOT maps to GET /bots/{appId}. Handwritten bootLivechat also PATCHes the audience user when user.user_id is present. Not LIVECHAT_OPEN/CLOSE widget JS.
WEBVIEW_GET_PARAMETER maps to GET /bots/{botId}/users/{userId}. Iframe query params have no REST; named fields live on the audience user.
LIVECHAT_UPDATE maps to PATCH /bots/{botId}/users/{userId} with flattened additional_attributes and avatar->picture.

WEBVIEW_SEND_RESPONSE maps to POST https://graph.botstar.com/webview as documented by the BotStar webview SDK. LIVECHAT_OPEN/CLOSE/ON_OPEN/ON_CLOSE remain BotStarApi widget JS with no Public API or graph HTTP route and are not stubbed.
